name: FastTrackAI Calories & Fasting

ios.desc:
Tired of manually logging every meal? FastTrack changes how you track your calories with its cutting-edge AI functionality. Simply tell your phone what you ate, and our smart assistant accurately logs your intake. No more guessing or searching through endless food databases.

Key Features:

Voice-to-calorie: Speak your meals, we'll track the calories
Personalized nutrition plan tailored to your goals
Weight tracking with "Zero Scale Anxiety" technology.
Easy-to-read progress charts and insights
Fasting tracker to support intermittent fasting routines
Photo recognition for visual food logging

Whether you're looking to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain a balanced diet, FastTrack makes it simple to stay on top of your nutrition goals. Our AI assistant understands context, portion sizes, and even complex meals, so you can focus on enjoying your food instead of counting calories.
Download FastTrack today and experience the future of effortless nutrition tracking. Your personal AI nutritionist is just a conversation away!

quotes.text:
I started this as a fasting tracker app, but then I realized I was using ChatGPT a lot for tracking my meals. It was a bit inconvenient as I couldn't make edits easily, no dedicated UI etc.

There were a lot of apps that have photo to calories functionality (this app has it too) but I find it much less useful than speaking, as I already weigh my stuff and actually read the nutritional info. So I've made this app, and I'd appreciate any sort of feedback.
